name: Prónoia
description: A crucial component of the administrative organization of [GetCountry('BYZ').GetName], Prónoiai were originally temporarily appointed fiscal collectors. However, the change in times forced them to change their obligations too. Turned now into hereditary posts that provide military assistance as well as extracting money from the territory, they continue to serve as an extension of the will of the Emperor.

name: Appanage
description: Appanages are a type of [subject|e] that represents lands ruled by a cadet branch of a ruling dynasty. An $appanage$ will get increased [ShowModifierTypeName('monthly_prestige')], at the cost of reduced [ShowModifierTypeName('country_cabinet_efficiency')], while the [overlord|e] will get increased [ShowModifierTypeName('monthly_legitimacy')] at the cost of more [ShowModifierTypeName('stability_decay')] and less [ShowModifierTypeName('global_crown_estate_power')].

name: Colonial Nation
description: A $colonial_nation$ is a [subject|e] centered around the administration of [overseas|e] [colonies|e] on behalf of its [overlord|e]. It benefits from increased [ShowModifierTypeName('global_population_capacity_modifier')] and the ability to use [ShowPopTypeName('slaves')] to work in the [rgo|e], while granting its [overlord|e] an upsurge of [merchant_power|e], as well as payment in [manpower|e] and [sailors|e] in addition to [gold|e].

name: Conquistador
description: Conquistadors are the leaders of a private army who have signed contracts with their [rulers|e] to explore and conquer certain territories in exchange for the title of Governor, and a share of the new lands and spoils. They are unique [subject_types|e] only able to be created through the [ShowGenericActionName('create_conquistador')] [action|e]. They are always [army_based|e] and they get increased [ShowModifierTypeName('military_tactics')], [ShowModifierTypeName('global_max_control')], and [ShowModifierTypeName('wrong_culture_levy_size')].

name: Dominion
description: A $dominion$ is a self-governed [subject|e] with relative autonomy, exclusive for a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] of the same [religion_group|e] as the [overlord|e]. Additionally, to be able to create a $dominion$, both countries must be in a [union|e] or the overlord must be either $ENG$ or $GBR$. A $dominion$ suffers reduced [ShowModifierTypeName('country_cabinet_efficiency')], compared to a regular [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')], but bigger [ShowModifierTypeName('legislative_efficiency')].

name: Fiefdom
description: A $fiefdom$ is a junior title that is the property of its [overlord|e]'s [ruler|e]. Exclusive for a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')] of the same [religion_group|e] as the overlord, it suffers reduced [ShowModifierTypeName('country_cabinet_efficiency')] and becomes ruled directly by the overlord's [monarch|e].

name: Member of the Hansa
description: The Hanseatic League is a confederation of mercantile cities with a defensive and commercial focus, spearheaded by the $HSA$. As a member of the Hanseatic League, this [subject|e] country enjoys increased [ShowModifierTypeName('selling_efficiency')], [ShowModifierTypeName('loyalty_to_overlord')], and [ShowModifierTypeName('merchant_maintenance_efficiency')]. The [overlord|e], which can only be the $HSA$, enjoys increased [ShowModifierTypeName('global_merchant_capacity_modifier')], as well as payment in form of [manpower|e] and [sailors|e] but less [gold|e] compared to a regular [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')].

name: Imperial Free City
description: The $imperial_free_city$ is a special subject bound to the [hre_emperor|e]. This status is active as long as the subject has the status of [ShowSpecialStatusName('free_city')] of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]. They can never be annexed, do not give any benefits to their [overlord|e] nor join them in wars, but they cost no [diplomatic_capacity|e] and can be turned into a [ShowSubjectTypeName('direct_imperial_free_city')] through the [ShowPolicyName('direct_imperial_cities_policy')] [policy|e].

name: Direct Imperial Free City
description: The $direct_imperial_free_city$ is a special subject bound to the [hre_emperor|e] allowed by the [ShowPolicyName('direct_imperial_cities_policy')] [policy|e]. This status is active as long as the subject has the status of [ShowSpecialStatusName('free_city')] of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]. They are the same as a normal [ShowSubjectTypeName('imperial_free_city')], but their autonomy is now vastly reduced, and thus they are can now be annexed, at a greater speed than a normal [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')].

name: March
description: A $march$ is a [subject|e] country focused on defending their [overlord|e]'s domain, acting as a barrier between their them and external threats. Marches enjoy greater [ShowModifierTypeName('discipline')] and [ShowModifierTypeName('global_defensive')], and increased [ShowModifierTypeName('fort_maintenance_efficiency')] as well as reduced payment obligations to their overlord compared to a normal [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')].

name: Sāmanta
description: A $samanta$ is a [subject|e] specific to countries with the [ShowAdvanceName('samanta_advance')] [advance|e], unique to [ShowCultureGroupName('indian_group')] countries. They mirror in many ways a normal [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')], but they have less payment obligations and cannot be [annexed|e] until their bond with their [overlord|e] becomes more intimate, turning them into a [ShowSubjectTypeName('maha_samanta')] through the [ShowCountryInteractionName('upgrade_to_maha_samanta')] [country_interaction|e].

name: Mahā-Sāmanta
description: The next step of the [ShowSubjectTypeName('samanta')], the $maha_samanta$ pays a greater deal of tribute to their [overlord|e] and can be [annexed|e] by their [overlord|e], at a greater speed than a normal [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')]. The [overlord|e] can also choose to grant a more trusting and autonomous role to the $maha_samanta$, turning them into a [ShowSubjectTypeName('pradhana_maha_samanta')] through the [ShowCountryInteractionName('upgrade_to_pradhana_maha_samanta')] [country_interaction|e].

name: Pradhāna-Mahā-Sāmanta
description: The exaltation of the [ShowSubjectTypeName('maha_samanta')] and the loyalest of [subjects|e]. The $pradhana_maha_samanta$ cannot be [annexed|e] and get greater [ShowModifierTypeName('discipline')], [ShowModifierTypeName('global_defensive')], and increased [ShowModifierTypeName('fort_maintenance_efficiency')], at the cost of reduced [ShowModifierTypeName('country_cabinet_efficiency')]. They also give greater payments of [gold|e], [manpower|e], and [sailors|e] to their [overlord|e]

name: Secessionists
description: This [subject|e] bears a multitude of similarities to its [overlord|e] in most facets of its administration and are keen to unite with them politically. As such, they can be [annexed|e] with relative ease. They get increased [ShowModifierTypeName('loyalty_to_overlord')] and increased [ShowModifierTypeName('annexation_speed')].

name: State Bank
description: This [subject|e] represents the strong connection between the subject as a company and its [overlord|e], which can only be a country with the [ShowGovernmentReformName('banking_country')] [government_reform|e]. They get increased [ShowModifierTypeName('diplomatic_reputation')], while the overlord gets reduced [ShowModifierTypeName('bank_interest')] and the ability to siphon half of the $state_bank$'s treasury with the [ShowCountryInteractionName('siphon_income')] [country_interaction|e] instead of the normal amount.

name: Trade Company
description: A $trade_company$ is an investment conglomerate, directed at incurring monetary benefits for itself and its [overlord|e]. They are always a [ShowGovernmentTypeName('republic')] and get increased [ShowModifierTypeName('export_efficiency')], as well as increased payment obligations to their overlord compared to a regular [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')].

name: Tributary
description: A tributary is a country that is forced to pay a periodic tribute to their [overlord|e] in the form of [gold|e], [manpower|e], and [sailors|e], and it is exclusive to certain forms of government. Compared to a regular [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')], tributaries are able to declare their own wars, even among themselves, but they will not automatically join their overlord's wars.

name: Tǔsī
description: A special type of administration of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName], they are hereditary governors of tribal lands on behalf of the imperial throne. They cannot be annexed, but they get increased [ShowModifierTypeName('monthly_towards_sinicized')] and are forced to use their [overlord|e]'s [court_language|e], while costing less [diplomatic_capacity|e].

name: Uç Bey
description: The $uc_bey$ is an [army_based|e] that serves as a frontier lord under strong $turkic_group$ leadership. Tasked with defending borders, leading raids, and expanding territories, these semi-autonomous leaders command loyal Ġuzāt warriors driven by religious fervor, plunder, and land grants, making them crucial to frontier stability and expansion. They can only be created through the [ShowGenericActionName('create_uc_bey')] [action|e], and they get the [ShowGovernmentReformName('uc_bey_reform')] [reform|e] and [ShowModifierTypeName('always_allow_army_levies')], while having greatly reduced payment obligations compared to a normal [ShowSubjectTypeName('vassal')] but costing increased [diplomatic_capacity|e] and giving their overlord more [ShowModifierTypeName('monthly_towards_decentralization')].

name: Vassal
description: The most typical type of [subject|e], a $vassal$ oversees its territory on behalf of its [overlord|e], pays vassal fees, and joins the military campaigns of its overlord. It suffers reduced [ShowModifierTypeName('country_cabinet_efficiency')], while the overlord gets increased [ShowModifierTypeName('monthly_prestige')], and both countries get faster spread of [institutions|e].
